description: Blue Bike deelfietsen Gent Sint-Pieters (M. Hendrikaplein) is a dataset listed in Open Data Portaal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Blue Bike. Deze data geeft real-time ( update elke 5 minuten) informatie over de Blue Bike fietsenstalling aan het station Gent Sint-Pieters (M. Hendrikaplein): Aantal fietsen in gebruik Aantal fietsen die nog beschikbaar zijn Op deze locatie is er een maximale capaciteit 3 5 Blue Bike fietsen. Coverage: Ghent. The portal files it under Mobiliteit. Its keywords are Deelmobiliteit, Fietsen. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik (https://www.vlaanderen.be/digitaal-vlaanderen/onze-oplossingen/open-data/voorwaarden-voor-het-hergebruik-van-overheidsinformatie/modellicentie-gratis-hergebruik). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stad-gent-portal.
